sculpt_ring_willow.author: sculpted for this project
sculpt_ring_willow.notes: Witch's ring gate for the broom courses (gameplay/wilds-rings.js, races.js): three twisted willow withies and a binding withy, eight brass bands with bead rims, a brass star charm, six ribbon streamers. Hoop radius 3.6 m in the XY plane (normal +Z), centre at the origin; the game scales it by radius / 3.6 and adds its own additive glow. One material (WitchRing, drawn double-sided for the ribbons). LOD tris 11324 / 4456 / 584. Vertex colour only (COLOR_0 linear rgb, written once).
